globalThis.__sections244=0;
register('route244',(n,p)=>{globalThis.__sections244++;return p.orbit(n)});

setcpm(240/4)

$: arrange([0.5, note("a3*4")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.05)
  .release(.03)
  .delay(0.4)
  .delaytime(0.125)
  .delayfeedback(0.35)
  .room(0.12)
  .roomsize(0.4)
  .route244(7)], [0.5, note("e4*4")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.05)
  .release(.03)
  .delay(0.4)
  .delaytime(0.125)
  .delayfeedback(0.35)
  .room(0.12)
  .roomsize(0.4)
  .route244(8)])

setcpm(240/4)

const form = arrange([0.5, note("a3*4")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.05)
  .release(.03)], [0.5, note("e4*4")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.05)
  .release(.03)])

$: form.delay(0.4).delaytime(0.125).delayfeedback(0.35).room(0.12).roomsize(0.4)
  .orbit(1)

$: form.delay(0.4).delaytime(0.125).delayfeedback(0.35).room(0.12).roomsize(0.4)
  .orbit(2)

globalThis.__sections244=0;
register('route244',(n,p)=>{globalThis.__sections244++;return p.orbit(n)});

setcpm(240/4)

const lead = note("a3*4")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.05)
  .release(.03)
  .delay(0.4)
  .delaytime(0.125)
  .delayfeedback(0.35)
  .room(0.12)
  .roomsize(0.4)
  .route244(7)

$: arrange([0.5, lead], [0.5, stack(lead, lead
  .rev())])
